title: El club Dumas
description: Lucas Corso, experto en rastrear libros raros, recibe dos encargos: autenticar un manuscrito de Los tres mosqueteros y comparar ejemplares de un tratado ocultista. Sus pesquisas lo conducen a un laberinto de coleccionistas, engaños y referencias literarias donde leer puede resultar peligroso.

en.description: Rare-book hunter Lucas Corso receives two assignments: authenticate a manuscript of The Three Musketeers and compare copies of an occult treatise. His investigations lead through a maze of collectors, deception and literary references, where reading can become a dangerous pursuit.
en.subtitle: a novel
en.title: The Club Dumas
